# Session — 2026-04-04 16:40

## What we were working on

Deploying the polymarket-bot to a Hetzner VPS using a two-service Docker architecture (`weather-bot` headless scanner on :8765, `dashboard` FastAPI proxy on :8766). The bot was crashing on startup (actually unhealthy, not crashing), the dashboard was inaccessible externally, and the bot was running in paper-trading mode when it should be executing live trades. We fixed the health check, confirmed both services healthy, switched to live trading, hardened the live/paper separation in `trader.py`, and fixed the web dashboard tab filtering so live positions don't bleed into the paper tab.

## Changes made

| File | What changed |
|------|-------------|
| `docker-compose.yml` | Health checks switched from `curl -f` to `python -c urllib.request` (curl not in slim image) |
| `docs/firewall-hetzner.md` | Replaced all `curl` health check commands with Python urllib equivalents |
| `src/polybot/cli.py` | Each scan in live mode now syncs `trader.balance`, `ds.live_balance`, `ds.live_mode` from real CLOB `get_balance()`; moved Telegram balance alert inside the sync block |
| `src/polybot/paper/trader.py` | `open_position`: split into hard live path (place order first, return `None` on failure — no phantom paper position) and paper path; added `logger.success("LIVE ORDER PLACED ...")` on confirmed fill; `close_position`: skips paper balance update when in live mode |
| `src/polybot/web/server.py` | `p.live` now uses `bool(t.clob_order_id or t.live_order_id)` (was missing US sports trades); paper tab position filter now excludes live positions (`!p.live`); `live_closed`/`live_open` stat arrays include sports live trades; position count badge corrected |

## Open problems

Problems are ordered **critical → high → medium → minor**.

### Critical

- [x] `CRIT-001` — `close_position` calls `self._clob.cancel_order(trade.clob_order_id)` to "close" a live position, but `clob_order_id` is the ID of the original *buy* order, which is already filled. Cancelling a filled order is a no-op. The position is never actually sold on-chain — no USDC is returned. **How to verify solved:** In `src/polybot/paper/trader.py`, grep for `cancel_order`. The closing logic must instead call a sell/redeem method (e.g. `place_order` with the opposite side, or a dedicated `redeem`/`sell` method on the CLOB client) not `cancel_order`.

- [x] `CRIT-002` — All pending code changes have not been deployed to the VPS yet (`docker compose up -d --build` has not been confirmed run since the last batch of fixes). The live instance is still running old code. **How to verify solved:** SSH to VPS and run `docker compose ps` — both services should show a `Started` time after 2026-04-04 16:40 UTC, and `docker compose exec weather-bot python -c "import polybot; print(polybot.__version__)"` (or check a known changed log line) should reflect the new build.

### High

- [x] `HIGH-001` — `_starting_balance()` returns `settings.paper_starting_balance` (default $1000) in all modes. In live mode, NAV%, total P&L%, and the sparkline baseline are all calculated against the wrong reference. The dashboard P&L% will be meaningless until this is fixed. **How to verify solved:** In `src/polybot/paper/trader.py`, `_starting_balance()` must return the real CLOB opening balance (or a configurable `live_starting_balance` setting) when `self.live_mode` is true. Grep for `_starting_balance` — it must branch on `live_mode`.

- [x] `HIGH-002` — External browser access to port 8766 was never confirmed working. `curl -v http://195.201.95.87:8766/health` timed out. User confirmed UFW and Hetzner firewall rules were set, and `ss -tlnp` showed docker-proxy listening, but we never got a successful external HTTP response. Root cause unresolved. **How to verify solved:** `curl -v http://195.201.95.87:8766/health` from an external machine returns HTTP 200 with JSON body.

### Medium

- [x] `MED-001` — Live position sizing still uses `settings.paper_max_position_usd` (default $10) as the per-position cap. There is no separate `LIVE_MAX_POSITION_USD` config. This means live trades are capped at $10 regardless of account size. **How to verify solved:** `src/polybot/config.py` must have a `live_max_position_usd` field (or equivalent), and `open_position` in `trader.py` must reference it when `self.live_mode` is true instead of `settings.paper_max_position_usd`.

- [x] `MED-002` — The terminal Rich dashboard still shows `──── PAPER ────` as a section divider even in live mode (`src/polybot/ui/dashboard.py` line ~537). This is confusing when `LIVE_TRADING=true`. **How to verify solved:** Grep `dashboard.py` for `PAPER ────` — the label must change to `──── LIVE ────` (or be removed) when `state.live_mode` is true.

### Minor

- [x] `MIN-001` — `docker-compose.yml` still contains the obsolete `version:` top-level key, producing a `WARN[0000] ... the attribute 'version' is obsolete` on every `docker compose` command. **How to verify solved:** `grep -n "^version" docker-compose.yml` returns no output.

- [x] `MIN-002` — The `resolve-issues` and `compress` skills were created this session but have not been end-to-end tested (this is their first run). **How to verify solved:** Run `/resolve-issues` against this session file and confirm it correctly identifies CRIT-002 as open (build not yet deployed) and updates the checkboxes in-place.
